capabilities: Sync conversations into one note per conversation with summary, tasks and transcript
Browse conversations and tasks in a side panel and insert pieces into notes
Render dashboards from fieldy code blocks or ready-made Dataview queries
Filter conversations out of the vault by keyword, speaker, place, template or time
Import full history and export notes to Markdown, JSON, CSV or plain text
extras: Written by an independent developer not affiliated with Fieldy and includes a referral link for the service. Detailed user guide and reference live on separate documentation pages. Mobile installs but is untested, with full support planned for 1.2. Privacy filters are explicitly not a security feature.
problem: Obsidian has no way to pull Fieldy conversation records into the vault as notes without duplicates, overwritten edits or manual copying.

relations.evidence: the plugin communicates only with the official Fieldy API
Fieldy notes also work with Dataview, with ready-made queries one command away
Fieldy tasks written in the Tasks plugin format inside notes

summary: Fieldy integration that syncs conversations, summaries, tasks and transcripts into structured Markdown notes, with a side panel browser and dashboards.
